ne945be00e0.headline: Iran Can Produce 10 Nuclear Bombs in 4 Months, Watchdog Says
ne945be00e0.summary: An analysis of the latest nuclear watchdog data says Iran can fuel six nuclear warheads within a month and ten within four months. The assessment comes from the latest data released by the watchdog.
ne945be00e0.why: Iran's nuclear programme shapes Middle East geopolitical risk, sanctions policy and energy-market sentiment.

n099c072957.headline: IAEA chief: Iran has expanded stock of near-weapons grade uranium | The Jerusalem Post
n099c072957.summary: The IAEA chief said Iran has expanded its stock of near-weapons-grade uranium. The development came as a surprise given recent progress between the West and Iran.
n099c072957.why: The IAEA is the UN nuclear watchdog that verifies Iran's nuclear commitments. Nuclear developments in Iran shape sanctions, oil-market risk premiums and broader Middle East geopolitical risk.

nbe7d56e6b8.headline: Waitrose lowers prices of further 250 products making everyday foods and roast dinners cheaper
nbe7d56e6b8.summary: Waitrose will lower prices on 250 popular autumn products from Wednesday 13 September. The range includes everyday foods such as pasta, whole chickens and sausages.

nb6769967bf.why: Budapest Stock Exchange listings give investors exposure to Hungarian real estate and property services.

n3efb0b6044.headline: BioLineRx Gets FDA Approval for Aphexda With Filgrastim
n3efb0b6044.summary: The US Food and Drug Administration approved Aphexda, motixafortide, in combination with filgrastim to mobilize stem cells for patients with multiple myeloma. BioLineRx announced the approval on Monday.
n3efb0b6044.why: BioLineRx is an Israeli biopharmaceutical company, and FDA approval is a key regulatory milestone that can unlock commercial sales in the United States.

n53cbb77629.summary: The European Commission's Summer 2023 interim forecast cut eurozone 2023 growth to 0.8% from 1.1% and 2024 to 1.3% from 1.6%. It also sees Germany in contraction this year.
n53cbb77629.why: The European Commission publishes the EU's official economic projections, which shape expectations for European Central Bank policy, the euro and regional equities. Germany is the eurozone's largest economy.

n364124fbbf.headline: Nifty scales 20,000 mount, Sensex regains 67,000 level as stocks extend rally to 7th day
n364124fbbf.summary: The Nifty crossed the record 20,000 mark for the first time while the Sensex rose 528 points to regain 67,000. Robust domestic investor buying extended the winning run to a seventh day.
n364124fbbf.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, covering 50 large listed companies. It is a key gauge of Indian equity market performance.
